description: Three opencode sessions, one local model (Qwen3.8 Flash Next MLX), one byte-identical verbatim brief, each loading a different design skill, each producing a five-iteration landing-page design for the same note-taking app. Source vendored under demos/<arm>; per-arm self-reports (recovered from the opencode session database) under results/<arm>.md; this file is the single source of numbers for the dashboard.
brief: I want you to design the landing page for a note-taking application as essentially a second brain. You should design five iterations and each of them should be accessible within the slash one, slash two, slash three like pages directory. And then you should add a little button that lets me switch between them easily.
briefNote: Byte-identical across all three arms (SHA eaebe847..., 318 characters), confirmed against the opencode session database in Task 2. It is carried per-arm below (rather than only once at the top) so each arm record is self-contained for the dashboard, but it is the same string three times, not three different briefs.
